apis.name: cellular_esim_download_profile_with_activationcode
apis.brief: Downloads the eSIM profile using a provided activation code. Initiates the download and installation of an eSIM profile. Uses a callback to communicate download progress and status back to the caller. \n (The string values are:- "download successful", "Activation Code decoded", "Initiate authentication done", "SM-DP+ address checking done", "Authenticate server done", "Authenticate client done", "PPR conditions check done", "Get Bound Profile Package done","Send PIR notification to server done", "Clear PIR notification done", "Read pending notifications...", "<1> pending notification(s) detected", "Processing notification #1 <33>", "Notification <33> successfully sent", "Load Bound Profile Package done - Profile download successful".)
apis.return_doc: Status of the download operation: TRUE - Download initiated successfully, modem present. FALSE - Download initiation error or modem not present. @note For detailed errors on FALSE, use lpaGetErrorCodeDescription(lpaGetErrorCode()).

apis.name: cellular_esim_download_profile_from_smds
apis.brief: Downloads an eSIM profile from an SMDS address. Initiates profile download by connecting to the specified SMDS server. @code "oem-smds-json.demo.gemalto.com" @endcode
apis.return_doc: Status of the download operation. RETURN_OK - Profile downloaded, ready for installation. RETURN_ERR - Download error (check specific error codes for details).

apis.name: cellular_esim_download_profile_from_defaultsmdp
apis.brief: Downloads an eSIM profile from a default SMDP+ address. Initiates profile download from a predefined SMDP+ address. SMDP+ is used for secure eSIM profile delivery. @code "smdp-plus.test.gsma.com" @endcode
apis.return_doc: Status of the download operation. RETURN_OK - Profile downloaded successfully. RETURN_ERR - Download error (e.g., invalid address, network issues, SMDP configuration errors).

apis.name: cellular_esim_get_profile_info
apis.brief: Retrieves a list of MNO profiles from the eSIM. Fetches information about available MNO profiles, providing a list and profile count. The function allocates memory for profile data.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation. RETURN_OK - Profiles retrieved successfully. RETURN_ERR - Error during retrieval (e.g., eSIM access issues, memory allocation failure, no profiles found). @note The caller must free the dynamically allocated memory for profile data.

apis.name: cellular_esim_enable_profile
apis.brief: Enables a Mobile Network Operator (MNO) profile matching the provided ICCID. Activates the eSIM profile corresponding to the given ICCID.  Verifies the ICCID against stored profiles.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation. RETURN_OK - Profile enabled successfully. RETURN_ERR - Error during enabling (e.g., no matching ICCID, invalid format, internal error).

apis.name: cellular_esim_disable_profile
apis.brief: Disables an eSIM profile matching the provided ICCID. Deactivates the eSIM profile with the specified Integrated Circuit Card Identification (ICCID). The ICCID must match exactly for successful disabling.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation. RETURN_OK - Profile disabled successfully. RETURN_ERR - Error during disabling (e.g., no matching ICCID, invalid format, internal error).

apis.name: cellular_esim_delete_profile
apis.brief: Deletes an eSIM profile matching the specified ICCID. Permanently removes the eSIM profile with the provided Integrated Circuit Card Identification (ICCID). The ICCID must match exactly for successful deletion.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation. RETURN_OK - Profile deleted successfully. RETURN_ERR - Error during deletion (e.g., no matching ICCID, invalid format, internal error).

apis.name: cellular_esim_lpa_init
apis.brief: Initializes the Local Profile Assistant (LPA) for eSIM management. Configures the LPA module, establishes modem readiness, and sets up dependencies and parameters for eSIM operations.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation. RETURN_OK - LPA initialized successfully. RETURN_ERR - Initialization error (e.g., modem issues, configuration problems, LPA SDK errors).

apis.name: cellular_esim_lpa_exit
apis.brief: Cleans up the Local Profile Assistant (LPA) for eSIM management. Deactivates the LPA module, releasing resources.  Call this before shutdown or when LPA functionality is no longer needed.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation. RETURN_OK - LPA uninitialized successfully. RETURN_ERR - Error during cleanup (e.g., resource release issues, ongoing operations, LPA module errors).

apis.name: cellular_esim_get_eid
apis.brief: Retrieves the EID (eUICC Identifier) from the device's eSIM. Fetches the unique identifier of the embedded SIM, essential for managing eSIM profiles and subscriptions.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation. RETURN_OK - EID retrieved successfully. RETURN_ERR - Error retrieving the EID (e.g., eSIM communication issues, eSIM not present, configuration errors).

apis.name: cellular_esim_get_euicc
apis.brief: Fetches information about the embedded Universal Integrated Circuit Card (eUICC). Retrieves details from the eUICC (or eSIM), providing data necessary for managing mobile subscriptions.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation. RETURN_OK - eUICC information retrieved successfully. RETURN_ERR - Error during retrieval (e.g., eUICC access issues, communication errors, configuration problems).
